Whether defeated Twilight Forest bosses schedule a respawn: once the countdown ends, the spawner block is restored in place and the structure's conquered mark is cleared (the map X disappears). When disabled, vanilla Twilight Forest behaviour is kept (bosses never respawn).
config.twilightregen.bossRespawnDelaySec: Delay in seconds (in-game time) between a boss's death and its spawner being restored. 300 = 5 minutes. The countdown is only resolved while the chunk is loaded; it never force-loads chunks.
config.twilightregen.bossRespawnMarkerBr: Whether the respawn countdown text can be destroyed by attacking it. Breaking it permanently cancels that respawn: the spawner is never restored and the structure stays conquered (the map X is kept). When disabled, the countdown cannot be interrupted.
